name: Electric Dual-Sided Shabu Shabu Hot Pot (Lid Missing)
description: Electric dual-sided Shabu Shabu and Mongolian hot pot in a vibrant red finish. Features a built-in internal divider that lets you enjoy two different broth flavors at the same time. Equipped with integrated cool-touch handles for safe carrying and an adjustable temperature control dial on the front plug base. Serves 2-6 people perfectly. Please note: The original transparent glass lid is missing, but the heating element and pot work perfectly. Selling very cheap for a graduation yard sale!
name_zh: 多功能一体式双面电热鸳鸯火锅 (无盖)
description_zh: 红色大容量一体式家用电热鸳鸯火锅。内设一体成型S型隔断，支持同时享用两种不同口味的底料（如麻辣与清汤）。两侧带有防烫把手，前方配有可调节多档控温旋钮，插电即用。加热速度快，满足2-6人聚餐需求。特别说明：原装透明玻璃盖子已丢失（不含盖子），但加热功能完全正常，不影响涮火锅。毕业搬家无脑低价处理！
